/**
 * @name Command injection via subprocess
 * @description Using subprocess with shell=True or unsanitized input can lead to command injection
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/click-command-injection
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    // subprocess.call, subprocess.run, subprocess.Popen with shell=True
    call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "run", "Popen", "check_call", "check_output"]).getACall() and
    exists(DataFlow::Node shellArg |
      shellArg = call.getArgByName("shell") and
      shellArg.asExpr().(BooleanLiteral).booleanValue() = true
    )
  ) or
  (
    // os.system calls
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("system").getACall()
  ) or
  (
    // os.popen calls
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("popen").getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe command execution that could allow command injection."
findings.hypothesis: Command injection through subprocess calls with shell=True or unsanitized user input

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Hardcoded credentials
 * @description Hardcoded passwords or API keys in source code
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/click-hardcoded-credentials
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-798
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::Node assign, string value
where
  exists(StrConst str |
    str = assign.asExpr() and
    value = str.getText() and
    (
      value.regexpMatch("(?i).*(password|passwd|pwd|secret|api[_-]?key|token|auth).*") and
      value.length() > 8 and
      not value.regexpMatch("(?i).*(example|test|dummy|placeholder|your_|<|>|\\{|\\}).*")
    )
  )
select assign, "Potential hardcoded credential: " + value
findings.hypothesis: Check for hardcoded passwords, API keys, or secrets in the code
